title: NT Catholic school parents warned of police presence amid terror probe
paragraphs: Parents at Northern Territory Catholic schools have been told to expect an increased police presence after two teenagers were charged with terrorism-related offences within in a week.
It comes after a teenage girl faced court on Wednesday charged with collecting or making documents likely to facilitate terrorist attacks, a week after a teenage boy faced court on the same charge.
Church leaders are calling for calm and unity, saying the police presence is "precautionary" and that "at no point we were aware there was any real threat to safety".
